project.title: Surface Microbiome Data of a Mega Hospital and its Surrounding Environments
project.description: We collected environmental swabs from the inpatient and outpatient departments of a large hospital, as well as from surrounding domestic waste treatment facilities, subway stations, and nearby university canteen, to investigate changes in microbial diversity.
project.center_name: West China School of Basic Medical Sciences & Forensic Medicine, Sichuan University
